question: The two rails of a railway track are parallel. If a section of one rail is 20 meters long and a section of the other is also 20 meters long, how many meters do the two sections differ in length? Calculate: \(20-20=?\)
solution: Both rail sections are 20 meters long, so their difference is \(20-20=0\) meters.
